title: General
description: Settings for how Typle is displayed and for signing in.

language.heading: Display language
language.description: Choose the language used on screen. Your word lists and practice records stay as they are.
language.note: The language you choose is saved in this browser.
language.failed: Could not change the display language. Please try again.

sessions.heading: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: Sign this account out of every device it is signed in on: this browser, other browsers, and the iPad, Mac, Android and Windows apps. Use this if you lose a device or think someone else has used your account. Every sign-in ends after 30 days on any device.
sessions.confirmDescription: Every device and app signed in now, this browser included, will be signed out. Sign in again on the devices you keep using. Your word lists and practice records are not deleted.
sessions.failed: Could not sign out. Please try again.
